environment.cache: OS cache is not evicted; reopen is not cold disk
environment.memory: Cache allowances are not total memory limits. PostgreSQL RSS sums double-count shared mappings. V8 heap cap is not an RSS limit.
environment.flushPolicy: SQLite fullfsync/checkpoint_fullfsync ON; PostgreSQL fsync_writethrough on Darwin, fsync elsewhere; iniBase retains Node FileHandle.sync. Actual hardware power loss not qualified.
environment.transport: PostgreSQL persistent Unix-domain connection; embedded engines direct calls. Connection setup reported separately.
